## What does this change help someone do?

Describe the scenario or improvement, and link to any related issue.

## How did you test it?

Include tool versions, the expected result, and any limitations. Do not include credentials, tenant IDs, or personal data.

## For new or updated samples

- [ ] The README explains prerequisites, permissions, and the expected result.
- [ ] Each advertised tool tab contains a complete, tested script.
- [ ] Destructive actions have a clear impact warning before the script.
- [ ] Metadata, author attribution, tested tool versions, and the preview are accurate.
- [ ] No template placeholders or private tenant details remain.
- [ ] The final README tracker points to this sample.

Need a hand? See the [contribution guide](../docs/contributing/preparing-a-submission.md). Every sample contributor is eligible for the [contributor badge](../docs/contributing/recognition.md) after their first accepted sample and recognition-program opt-in.
